title: Exporting Your Resume - Resume Builder - The Basics
description:
LIKE & SUBSCRIBE for you more Resume, Job Search & Career Growth content!

Are you ready to export your resume like a pro?  In this video, we'll walk you through the easy steps to get your resume out of Teal and into the world! Whether you’re applying for jobs or need a polished cover letter, we’ve got you covered. Let’s take your job application game to the next level! 

What We Will Cover: 
- How to export your resume as a PDF 
- Previewing your resume before export 
- Exporting cover letters as joint PDFs 
- Naming and saving your files correctly 
- Troubleshooting minor formatting issues 

Questions Answered in This Video: 
- How do I export my resume from Teal? 
- Can I export cover letters too? 
- What should I name my resume file? 
- Why do I see formatting differences in the preview and the PDF? 
- How do I fix export issues with my resume?
